scope: Theorem 2.5 (Original-data rigidity) of the manuscript “Equality and rigidity in the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Equality-and-rigidity-in-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f1aab59ba484eb8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose an exterior in Definition 2.4 attains equality in (2.9). There is a global smooth spacelike embedding of the entire Ω, including S, into the regular extension of one exterior of Gm, inducing exactly the original g and K with convention (2.11). The image lies in the domain r > rm together with its corresponding future horizon and bifurcation sphere. The boundary maps to a full smooth section of that future horizon or to its bifurcation sphere. The embedding and future unit normal extend smoothly to S in horizon-regular coordinates, and the chosen end approaches spatial infinity. There is no conclusion about a region behind S.
